```{r}
# 建立對數-線性模型
mod_a <- lm(log(price) ~ sqft, data = collegetown)
summary(mod_a)

# 計算樣本平均數
mean_price <- mean(collegetown$price)
mean_sqft <- mean(collegetown$sqft)

# 提取 beta_2 的估計值
beta2_hat <- coef(mod_a)["sqft"]

# Slope at sample mean (dy/dx = beta2 * y)
slope_a <- beta2_hat * mean_price 

# Elasticity at sample mean ((dy/dx) * (x/y) = beta2 * x)
elasticity_a <- beta2_hat * mean_sqft

cat("Slope at mean:", slope_a, "\n")
cat("Elasticity at mean:", elasticity_a, "\n")
```
```{r}
# 建立雙對數模型
mod_b <- lm(log(price) ~ log(sqft), data = collegetown)
summary(mod_b)

# 提取 alpha_2 的估計值
alpha2_hat <- coef(mod_b)["log(sqft)"]

# Slope at sample mean (dy/dx = alpha2 * (y/x))
slope_b <- alpha2_hat * (mean_price / mean_sqft)

# Elasticity (在 Log-log 模型中為常數 alpha2)
elasticity_b <- alpha2_hat

cat("Slope at mean:", slope_b, "\n")
cat("Elasticity:", elasticity_b, "\n")
```
```{r}
# 建立線性模型
mod_c <- lm(price ~ sqft, data = collegetown)

# 取得線性模型的 R-squared
r2_c <- summary(mod_c)$r.squared

# 計算 Log 模型的 Generalized R-squared
# 公式: R^2_g = [cor(y, y_hat)]^2，需將 log(y_hat) 取 exp 還原
pred_y_a <- exp(fitted(mod_a))
r2_gen_a <- cor(collegetown$price, pred_y_a)^2

pred_y_b <- exp(fitted(mod_b))
r2_gen_b <- cor(collegetown$price, pred_y_b)^2

# 整理成表格輸出
r2_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Linear", "Log-Linear (Gen R^2)", "Log-Log (Gen R^2)"),
  R_Squared = c(r2_c, r2_gen_a, r2_gen_b)
)
knitr::kable(r2_results, digits = 4)
```
```{r}
# 提取殘差
res_a <- residuals(mod_a)
res_b <- residuals(mod_b)
res_c <- residuals(mod_c)

# 畫出殘差的直方圖
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
hist(res_a, main="Residuals: Log-Linear", xlab="", col="lightblue")
hist(res_b, main="Residuals: Log-Log", xlab="", col="lightgreen")
hist(res_c, main="Residuals: Linear", xlab="", col="salmon")
par(mfrow=c(1,1))

# 執行 Jarque-Bera 常態性檢定
jb_a <- jarque.bera.test(res_a)
jb_b <- jarque.bera.test(res_b)
jb_c <- jarque.bera.test(res_c)

jb_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Log-Linear", "Log-Log", "Linear"),
  X_squared = c(jb_a$statistic, jb_b$statistic, jb_c$statistic),
  p_value = c(jb_a$p.value, jb_b$p.value, jb_c$p.value)
)
knitr::kable(jb_results, digits = 6)
```
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
plot(collegetown$sqft, res_a, main="Log-Linear Res vs SQFT", ylab="Residuals", xlab="SQFT", pch=16, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.5))
abline(h=0, col="red", lwd=2)

plot(collegetown$sqft, res_b, main="Log-Log Res vs SQFT", ylab="Residuals", xlab="SQFT", pch=16, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.5))
abline(h=0, col="red", lwd=2)

plot(collegetown$sqft, res_c, main="Linear Res vs SQFT", ylab="Residuals", xlab="SQFT", pch=16, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.5))
abline(h=0, col="red", lwd=2)
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
```
```{r}
new_data <- data.frame(sqft = 27)

# Model (a) Log-linear (需轉換 exp)
pred_a <- exp(predict(mod_a, newdata = new_data, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95))

# Model (b) Log-log (需轉換 exp)
pred_b <- exp(predict(mod_b, newdata = new_data, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95))

# Model (c) Linear
pred_c <- predict(mod_c, newdata = new_data, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)

# 整理預測結果
pred_results <- rbind(
  Log_Linear = pred_a,
  Log_Log = pred_b,
  Linear = pred_c
)
knitr::kable(pred_results, digits = 2, caption = "Predicted Price & 95% PI (in thousands of dollars)")
```
